description: Explicit synthetic CARDINAL scenario routing for the five verified kg-react-epic LaunchPad patients. Epic SMART provides the real FHIR Patient ID; Patient.Read verifies the identity; this file maps only the canonical verified patient key to demo scenarios. No ID placeholders and no unknown-patient hash fallback.
